focus_areas: Sharpness and physical plausibility of embossed patterns
Consistency of metallic reflections across the curved surface
Structural integrity of the bottom hem and side edges
Presence and realism of attachment hardware (rivets/loops)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'embossed' patterns. In AI images, these often look like flat textures rather than raised metal. Check if the lighting highlights on the ridges of the chevrons match the global light source. Also, scrutinize the bottom edge for any 'melting' into the background or inconsistent thickness.
image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a metallic breastplate (cuirass) mounted against a plain, light-colored wall. The armor is silver-toned with a matte-to-satin finish rather than a mirror polish. It features embossed geometric chevron patterns radiating from the center. The plate has a distinct central vertical ridge and curved lateral edges. Rivets are visible along the bottom hem and near the shoulder areas. There are no visible leather straps attached, only metal loops or rivet holes at the top corners.

expert_testimonies.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from generic metal plates or other armor types.
To verify the continuity of the metal plate and check for boundary bleeding into the background, especially at the bottom hem.
To analyze the realism of the metallic reflections and the physical plausibility of the embossed patterns.
